title: Pan-Seared Samphire with Spicy Skillet Sauce
description: A quick and flavorful side dish, featuring the unique taste of samphire and a spicy kick.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the samphire to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the hot sauce and lemon juice.
Pour the spicy sauce over the skillet and samphire mixture.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with american cheese if desired.
